en.heroSub: LLM Agents · Reinforcement Learning · Automated Algorithm Discovery for smarter urban mobility
en.heroBio: Final-year PhD candidate in AI at Monash University (expected October 2026) and visiting researcher at KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Digital Futures). My research explores how LLM agents and reinforcement learning can automate the discovery and optimization of decision-making algorithms for transportation systems — with first-author work in TR-C, COMMTR and IEEE OJ-ITS, released as the open-source projects LLMTraveler, MARL4TA and EvolveSignal.

pubs.title: EvolveSignal: A Large Language Model Powered Coding Agent for Discovering Traffic Signal Control Algorithms
pubs.authors: L Wang, P Duan, H Wang, Y Wang, J Xu, N Zheng, Z Ma
pubs.note: LLM-driven program synthesis that evolves interpretable signal-control heuristics — 20.1% lower average delay and 47.1% fewer stops than Webster's method.

pubs.title: Agentic Large Language Models for Day-to-Day Route Choices
pubs.authors: L Wang, P Duan, Z He, C Lyu, X Chen, N Zheng, L Yao, Z Ma
pubs.journal: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
pubs.note: LLM decision agents with long-term memory and persona for day-to-day route choice — matching econometric and RL baselines at a fraction of the modeling cost. Fully open source.

pubs.title: Scalable and Reliable Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Traffic Assignment
pubs.authors: L Wang, P Duan, C Lyu, Z Wang, Z He, N Zheng, Z Ma
pubs.note: OD-pair router agents with Dirichlet policies reduce agent count by two orders of magnitude and cut the relative gap by 94.99% on Sioux Falls.

pubs.title: Reinforcement Learning-based Sequential Route Recommendation for System-Optimal Traffic Assignment
pubs.authors: L Wang, P Duan, C Lyu, Z Ma
pubs.journal: IEEE Open Journal of Intelligent Transportation Systems
pubs.note: MSA-guided deep Q-learning recasts static system optimum as sequential decisions — 0.35% gap to the theoretical optimum on the OW network.

pubs.title: Data-driven Analysis and Modeling of Individual Longitudinal Behavior Response to Fare Incentives in Public Transport
pubs.authors: L Wang, X Chen, Z Ma, P Zhang, B Mo, P Duan

pubs.title: Human-centric Multimodal Deep (HMD) Traffic Signal Control
pubs.authors: L Wang, Z Ma, C Dong, H Wang
pubs.note: Passenger-weighted human-centric reward with D3QN — up to 19.2% lower per-capita delay than fixed-time control.

points: Lightweight open-source LLM pipeline for individual mobility prediction (PEFT + prompt design with spatiotemporal context).
Feedback-driven automated feature-discovery framework — LLM-generated feature functions iteratively refined by prediction performance, ~10% accuracy gain over uniform features.
Gradient-free black-box optimization (Bayesian optimization, evolution strategies, multi-objective search) for braking-system matching and vehicle simulation calibration.
Interactive SUMO/TraCI simulation and evaluation environment for RL-based adaptive traffic signal control.

experience.role: Teaching & Research Supervision · Monash University & KTH
points: Head TA for Deep Learning and Cloud Computing and Security (Monash); TA for AI for Transportation (KTH) — course design, practice classes, and LLM/RL project supervision.
Supervised a KTH master's thesis on LLM-guided evolutionary discrete choice modelling (journal submission under review).
